'''D3-C0''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was present at the [[Jedi Colony]] during the [[Invasion of Ossus]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=location|Ossus}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
